title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the Kambia, Karene and Port Loko districts of Sierra Leone, contributes to outcome 2.1 Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic wellbeing. The objective is to increase the adoption of agroecological approaches at household and community levels. Activities include community led food security and nutrition assessments, and provision of agroecology training and inputs to increase sustainable food, livelihood security and resilience to climate. The programme is in partnership with Action for Advocacy and Development Sierra Leone, Cotton Tree Foundation and Kambia District Development and Rehabilitation Organisation. Other partners may be included. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 2.1Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic well-being. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this outcome is:• Strengthening the resilience of poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, through promotion of diverse climate resilient agriculture for food and nutrition security including the adoption of agroecological approaches, seed sovereignty, improved food storage and preservation, and agrobiodiversity, soil conservation measures and trees on farms.• Community-led food and nutrition security analysis and planning using the 6 UN Dimensions of Food Security. It incorporates the co-creation and sharing of knowledge that enables farmers to adapt to their changing local conditions and to increase their resilience by reducing and adapting to the impacts of climate change and environmental degradation. This work contributes to the availability of diverse food sources in target communities, and in turn, to improved nutrition outcomes.
